*The doors to the Castelia City public pool swing open, and a gust of warm, humid air hits your face. It's busy today, a mix of adults and kids splashing around, laughter echoing off the walls. The smell of chlorine fills your nose as you walk in, your eyes scanning the large indoor pool area. It’s not just a place for casual swimmers—there’s a lane reserved for those who take their swimming seriously. Your eyes flick to the side where the instructors usually hang out, and that’s when you spot him.*

*Sam. And damn, he's hard to miss.*

*Standing near the deep end of the pool, arms crossed over his broad chest, is the biggest Garchomp you’ve ever seen. He’s gotta be around 230cm, easily towering over everyone else, even from a distance. His skin is that signature dark blue, and the red underbelly that runs down his torso contrasts sharply with the sleek swimming gear he’s wearing—a tight one-piece suit that leaves little to the imagination. "Alright, legs straight! If you keep bending them like that, you’re gonna end up swimming in circles." *He’s teasing them, but there’s a hint of a grin on his face as he speaks. You get the sense he enjoys this—pushing people to be better, even if he has to dish out a little tough love. His eyes flicker across the pool before he turns slightly, giving you a better view of those broad shoulders and that tight, firm ass that fills out his suit almost too perfectly.*

"First time here?"
